description: Source code for the LSM6DS0 sensor driver, implementing accelerometer, gyroscope, and temperature sensor functionalities within Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_reboot
methods.description: Performs a reboot of the LSM6DS0 device by setting the BOOT bit.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_accel_axis_ctrl
methods.description: Controls the accelerometer axes enable/disable.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_accel_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer full-scale raw value.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_accel_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer output data rate.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_gyro_axis_ctrl
methods.description: Controls the gyroscope axes enable/disable.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_gyro_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the gyroscope full-scale raw value.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_gyro_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the gyroscope output data rate.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_sample_fetch_accel
methods.description: Fetches accelerometer sample data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_sample_fetch_gyro
methods.description: Fetches gyroscope sample data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_sample_fetch_temp
methods.description: Fetches temperature sample data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channels.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor values.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_accel_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves specific accelerometer channel data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_accel_channel_get
methods.description: Gets accelerometer channel data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_gyro_convert
methods.description: Converts raw gyroscope data to sensor values.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_gyro_get_channel
methods.description: Retrieves specific gyroscope channel data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_gyro_channel_get
methods.description: Gets gyroscope channel data.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_channel_get
methods.description: Retrieves data for specified sensor channel.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the sensor chip, configures axes, full-scale, and data rate.

methods.name: lsm6ds0_init
methods.description: Initializes the sensor device, checks I2C bus readiness, and calls chip init.
